column3: Closest parallel: detailing signs makes return possible, balancing route disclosure with restoration.

Names a people as criminal at the point of prophetic complaint, adding a communal case.
Shows varied presentation of signs and divergent reception, clarifying that disclosure does not compel response.
Supplies an earlier warning-and-response stage before the later exposure of a wrongful course.
